title: A Clock for Everyone
fact_notes: オリジナル教材。人物や出来事は架空の例であり、実在の事業・調査・実証結果ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: Students in three countries plan to meet online once a month to share ideas about their school lives.
sentences.ja: 三か国の生徒が学校生活の考えを共有するため月一回オンラインで会う計画を立てる。

sentences.en: The organizing team selects a meeting time that fits conveniently into its own school schedule.
sentences.ja: 主催班は自校の日程に都合よく合う会合時刻を選ぶ。

sentences.en: However, the participants soon discover that the local time of the meeting differs considerably among their communities.
sentences.ja: しかし参加者は会合の現地時刻が地域間でかなり異なることにすぐ気づく。

sentences.en: A convenient afternoon activity for one group may take place before breakfast or late in the evening for another.
sentences.ja: 一集団に都合のよい午後の活動が別の集団には朝食前や夜遅くに行われる場合がある。

sentences.en: The organizers initially search for a single meeting time that would be equally convenient for everybody.
sentences.ja: 当初主催者は全員に同じように都合のよい単一会合時刻を探す。

sentences.en: They recognize that the problem cannot necessarily be solved by identifying the mathematical difference between time zones.
sentences.ja: タイムゾーンの数学的な差を特定するだけで必ずしも問題は解けないと認識する。

sentences.en: The school schedules, family responsibilities, and availability of internet access may differ even among students living in the same city.
sentences.ja: 学校日程、家族への責任、インターネット利用可能性は同じ都市に住む生徒間でさえ異なり得る。

sentences.en: The organizers consequently ask the participating groups about the practical conditions under which their students could join a session.
sentences.ja: そこで参加集団に生徒が参加できる実務条件を尋ねる。

sentences.en: One group proposes rotating the meeting time so that the inconvenience does not always affect the same participants.
sentences.ja: 一集団は不便が常に同じ参加者に影響しないよう会合時刻を交代させる提案をする。

sentences.en: Another suggests allowing students to contribute short recorded presentations or written questions when joining a live meeting is difficult.
sentences.ja: 別集団はライブ会合への参加が困難なら短い録画発表や書面質問を提出できるよう提案する。

sentences.en: Such contributions would not reproduce every aspect of a live conversation, but they could provide additional opportunities for participation.
sentences.ja: その提出物はライブ会話の全側面を再現しないが追加の参加機会を提供し得る。

sentences.en: The teams discuss which parts of the project require immediate interaction and which can be completed at different times.
sentences.ja: 活動のどの部分に即時相互作用が必要でどの部分が異なる時刻に完了できるか議論する。

sentences.en: They eventually prepare a shared schedule indicating the relevant local times for each group.
sentences.ja: 最終的に各集団に関連する現地時刻を示す共有日程を作る。

sentences.en: They explain how students can contribute when they are unable to attend a particular meeting.
sentences.ja: 特定会合に出席できない時の貢献方法を説明する。

sentences.en: The fictional project does not establish a universally suitable schedule for international exchanges.
sentences.ja: 架空活動は国際交流に普遍的に適した日程を確立しない。

sentences.en: It illustrates how expanding participation may require examining the structure of an activity rather than merely inviting more students to join it.
sentences.ja: 参加拡大には単により多くの生徒を招待するのでなく活動構造の検討が必要な場合があることを示す。

sentences.en: A global invitation can reach people in many countries without providing them with identical opportunities to participate.
sentences.ja: 世界規模の招待は多くの国々に届いても同一参加機会を提供するとは限らない。

sentences.en: Meaningful cooperation requires attention to the circumstances that shape those opportunities.
sentences.ja: 意味ある協力には機会を形作る事情への注意が必要だ。

sentences.en: A clock tells us when an activity takes place, but it cannot determine whether the arrangement serves the needs of everyone involved.
sentences.ja: 時計は活動時刻を伝えるが仕組みが関係者全員の必要に役立つかは決定できない。

sentences.en: That question must be discussed by the people who hope to meet across distances.
sentences.ja: その問いは距離を越えて会おうとする人々が議論しなければならない。

vocabulary.definition: in a way fitting one's needs
groups of people connected by place
in a way that must occur
things one is expected to do
ability to reach or use something
in a way applying to all

options: A trip to one country every week.
Monthly online meetings about school life.
A joint examination in a single classroom.
questions.explanation_ja: 月一回のオンライン交流。

questions.prompt: Why might the initial time be unsuitable?
options: All schools follow exactly the same schedule.
It falls at different local times for other groups.
Every country has the same time zone.

questions.prompt: Why is time-zone calculation alone insufficient?
options: School and personal circumstances also affect availability.
Students can attend every meeting at any time.

questions.prompt: What do organizers ask participating groups?
options: About the number of countries in the world.
To remove the need for communication.
To ensure the same group always attends early.
questions.explanation_ja: 不便が偏らないように。

questions.prompt: What limitation do recorded contributions have?
options: They do not reproduce all aspects of a live conversation.
They cannot provide any opportunity to participate.
They require every participant to join simultaneously.
questions.explanation_ja: ライブの全側面は再現できない。

options: Relevant local times for each group.
Inviting more people without any changes.
Changing how the activity is organized.

questions.prompt: Which statement best expresses the argument?
options: One meeting time always works equally well for every country.
International exchanges should consider practical participation opportunities, not simply issue invitations.
Recorded contributions must replace every live exchange.
Time-zone mathematics solves all participation problems.
questions.explanation_ja: 参加機会の実質的な確保。

grammar.explanation_ja: mayは可能性、take placeは行われる。

grammar.focus: cannot necessarily be solved by identifying
grammar.explanation_ja: not necessarilyは部分否定、by＋動名詞。
wouldは仮想の結果、部分否定。

grammar.focus: without providing them with identical opportunities

paraphrases.source: A convenient afternoon activity for one group may take place before breakfast or late in the evening for another.
paraphrases.rewrite: An afternoon session for one group may occur very early or late for another.

paraphrases.source: They recognize that the problem cannot necessarily be solved by identifying the mathematical difference between time zones.
paraphrases.rewrite: Knowing the time difference does not always resolve scheduling difficulties.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 時差計算だけでは不十分。

paraphrases.source: Such contributions would not reproduce every aspect of a live conversation, but they could provide additional opportunities for participation.
paraphrases.rewrite: Recorded contributions can offer participation but cannot fully replace live discussion.

paraphrases.source: A global invitation can reach people in many countries without providing them with identical opportunities to participate.
paraphrases.rewrite: Inviting people internationally does not guarantee equal participation opportunities.
